descriptionText:
WITRON develops intralogistics and automation systems for distribution centers. The Junior IT Developer supports the Material Flow Control team by developing and maintaining software that coordinates material movement, interfaces with hardware, and works with the Warehouse Management System.
Responsibilities
Working together with the responsible team-lead or project-lead to create technical solutions for our existing WWMS application. Areas of work include, for example routing configuration for new warehouses, traffic analysis, coding new or improving existing action point handling, debugging or researching reported issues or questions around traffic routing, developing new and expanding existing interfaces to add features and new support new hardware components
Development, testing, and deployment of change requests, projects, assignments in a collaborative international team environment or working individually on isolated issues
If you see something, say something: Supporting and improving existing and/or new applications and functionalities
Creation of technical documents and specifications for your solutions to allow maintainability of your software
Collaborating with our analyst team on topics that come up during project ramp-up, development, testing and after final acceptance
All hands on deck during on-site project commissioning and ramp-up. You’ll be working on north American based projects (USA and Canada)
Limited communication with clients within the respective field and independent decision-making based on knowledge level
Based on experience, knowledge level, and personal preference responsibilities will be expanded to never run out of interesting tasks
Skills
You can demonstrate practical experience developing software in C/C++ environments, possess a solid understanding of software development fundamentals, coding practices, and problem-solving techniques, and have exposure to background processes, multithreading, and system-level programming concepts
Basic knowledge of PL/SQL
Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with both local and international colleagues and customers in English, across technical and non-technical contexts
Ability to be a team player, work and support the team especially under pressure and take responsibility within your area of expertise
Great attitude towards solving big problems and a “Can-Do” attitude
Bachelor's degree in computer science/engineering or equivalent experience combined with some educational experience
Experience should include project design, coding, testing, delivery and technical documentation of GitHub projects, or personal coding examples, class projects or previous professional assignments
Ideally you are proficient in C, with good working knowledge of C++
Ideally, you have projects to showcase during the interview process
Helpful but not required: Familiarity with the Visual Studio IDE, including Team Foundation Server (TFS)/Azure DevOps source control, debugging, and day-to-day development workflows
Helpful but not required: Exposure to logistics industry / terminology
Helpful but not required: Exposure to large codebases
We value team players, practical experience, problem-solving ability, “Can do”-Attitude and a great personality - whether you learned through school, self-study, online courses, or hands-on project
Logistics exposure is helpful but not required
Benefits
Three bonus opportunities; participation in the WITRON bonus program once eligible.
Comprehensive health benefits.
Company-paid Basic Life, Dependent Life, AD&D, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability Insurance.
401(k) match.
Dental Insurance.
Vision Insurance.
Accident Insurance.
Hospital Indemnity Insurance.
Critical Illness Insurance.
Added benefits or bonuses to celebrate certain employee milestones.
Brand-name work apparel and professional tools.
Team environment, collaboration, open-door policy, company events, and team-building measures.
Career development and advancement opportunities; employee potential is recognized and supported.
Occasional remote work after 6 months, depending on individual work-style, performance, and gained knowledge.
Company Overview
WITRON designs and implements innovative logistics and material flow systems with trend-setting ergonomic work places and processes that offer their customers sustainable competitive advantages. It was founded in 1971, and is headquartered in Parkstein, Bayern, DEU, with a workforce of 5001-10000 employees. Its website is https://www.witron.com.
Company H1B Sponsorship
WITRON Group has a track record of offering H1B sponsorships, with 1 in 2022. Please note that this does not guarantee sponsorship for this specific role.
